A '''variant''' of [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]],<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammals]] originating on the<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC Dathomir Ottethan">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir]] and [[Ottethan system/Legends|Ottethan systems]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and [[Ottethan/Legends|Ottethan]],<ref name="NEGAS" /> inhabited the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] planet [[Persappa]]. The Persappa rancors had blue-spotted [[Color/Legends|coloring]] and were [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]].<ref name="TUR" />
